svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 10 / ARCHAEOLOGY
svg.desc: 24,679 GitHub contributions across 168 active days, 2025-11-09 to 2026-11-14. The miner excavates real dates in ascending contribution-count order. Counts set quartz, copper, gold and diamond tiers. Excavating a consecutive five-day streak reveals a treasure chest.
